title: CE-RM: A Pointwise Generative Reward Model Optimized via Two-Stage Rollout and Unified Criteria

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a two-stage rollout method with unified, query-based criteria to prevent the model from generating inconsistent evaluation standards that vary based on the specific response content during pairwise comparisons.

Evaluating the generative reward model on RM-Bench to test its robustness under subtle content differences, assessing whether the model accurately judges based on content rather than being swayed by writing style or formatting.
